description:
READ-ONLY. The other half of migration risk that a file-scan misses: DATABASE-level customizations,
    above all **Odoo Studio** changes - which are NOT in any module's files but live in the DB as manual
    records. Introspects the live DB for: (1) STUDIO/manual FIELDS (`ir.model.fields` state='manual' -
    the `x_studio_*`/`x_*` fields), with their model, type, related-path and comodel; (2) STUDIO custom
    MODELS (`ir.model` state='manual', the `x_*` models); (3) STUDIO VIEWS (owned by studio_customization).
    Then cross-references each against the target major's REMOVED-field reference (odoo_removed_fields.json,
    from the source diff): a Studio field whose `related`/comodel points at a core field/model REMOVED in
    the target is flagged as a migration RISK (its related path or relation breaks). Pair with
    addon_migrate_assess (which covers custom-CODE modules) for the full picture: code + Studio. Nothing
    is modified. `target_major` defaults to current+1.
name: migration_customization_scan
